title: fun. - We Are Young [V6]
description: Initial version with the first verse. The verse is at same tempo as the hook on this version. According to Nate Reuss, "I was so scared of Jeff: He was already doing everything I wanted, and because he's like this god in my mind, I didn't want to say, 'OK, we need to do this double-time. We need to speed that verse up.' Because he's a hip-hop guy, and he's used to doing one beat throughout a song. When I first brought it up, Jeff was livid that I would even want to try something like changing the tempo. But he tried it, and he thought it was terrific, and he loved my slow vocal on the verse - that's my original take on the slow verse, but it's been sped up."
